svg.title: Interaction storyboard: one team, one tested edit, one visible effect

text.tspan: Four states of one embedded figure. The reader sees one state at a time.
What happens if you change one move?
The rest of the team stays fixed.
Choose an edit to reveal its estimated change and uncertainty.
Battle counts, opponent pool and interval method ⌄
What happens if you change one move?
The rest of the team stays fixed.
This example's interval sits below zero.
Battle counts, opponent pool and interval method ⌄
Do edits affect both groups equally?
Each dot summarizes the tested edits around one starting team.
Select a dot to inspect that team's roster and tested edits.
Edit sampling, battle noise and summary definition ⌄
Choose a reference and a benchmark. Keep the comparison visible.
Same display; the scale and neighborhood definitions remain visible.
Objective normalization and neighborhood step sizes ⌄
Action: select a Pokémon, then choose one of its tested move replacements.
Updates: one edit and its effect. Retains: original team, zero reference and comparison scale.
Try another replacement or undo it. The team remains in view.
“Compare 100 teams” swaps in state 3; “Benchmarks” swaps in state 4.
Selecting a team returns to the edit view with that team selected.
Changing the comparator replaces one distribution, preserving the reference.
